title: RLVR$^{2}$: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rubric-based Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2609.23457v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is expanding from tasks with well-defined correctness signals, such as mathematics and code, toward multifaceted quality requirements specified by multi-dimensional rubrics. Since policy optimization consumes one scalar per rollout, rubric-based pipelines must map multiple criterion scores into a scalar reward. This aggregation is often treated as score scaling, but it implicitly determines how quality dimensions trade off during training. The prevailing practice, normalizing each criterion and taking a linear combination, assumes that cardinal score differences are comparable across criteria and that gains on one criterion compensate for failures on another; both assumptions are unreliable when criteria are semantically heterogeneous. translated_title: RLVR²：基于可验证评分量规排序的强化学习
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）正在从具有明确定义正确性信号的任务（如数学和代码）扩展到由多维度评分量规指定的多方面质量要求。由于策略优化在每次 rollout 中只消耗一个标量，基于评分量规的流程必须将多个标准的得分聚合为标量奖励。这种聚合通常被视为简单的分数缩放，但它实际上隐式地决定了训练过程中各质量维度之间的权衡方式。目前主流的做法是对每个标准进行归一化后取线性组合，这隐含地假设了基数分数差异在各标准之间是可比的，并且某一标准上的收益可以补偿另一标准上的失败；当各标准在语义上异质时，这两种假设都不可靠。我们提出了基于可验证评分量规排序的强化学习（RLVR²），这是一种面向基于评分量规的 RLVR 的可验证排序范式。对于每个标准……
tldr: 本文提出RLVR²，一种基于可验证评分量规排序的强化学习范式，用排序机制取代线性分数聚合，解决了多维度语义异质质量标准在RLVR训练中权衡不可靠的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RLVR², a verifiable ranking-based paradigm for rubric-guided RLVR that replaces linear score aggregation with ranking to address the unreliable trade-offs among semantically heterogeneous quality criteria.
